text: Vietnam. What's the first thing that comes to your mind? Hanoi, lanterns, con hats, street food, Saigon, egg, coffee, history, rice fields, temples, Harlong Bay or train street? Everyone has their own bucket list. And on this list, Vietnam ranks among the best. I have lived, worked, and traveled this beautiful, diverse country for over 7 months, and now I want to share my knowledge and experience with you. This is how I would spend 14 days in Vietnam. You will be either arriving in Ho Chi Min or Hanoi. For the sake of simplicity, we start from Hanoi. No worries. This journey works also in reverse. Our journey begins in the lively streets of Hanoi, where the pulse of the city sets the tone for our Vietnam exploration. From Hanoi, we embark on a night bus to Sappa, nestled in the majestic mountains of northern Vietnam, surrounded by verdant rice terraces and the warm hospitality of the local hill tribes. Next, we journey by night bus to Catbar, a picturesque island, where we will do a road trip across the island by motorbike. Our next destination is the legendary Harlong Bay, where we spend a night aboard a cruise ship, sailing among the iconic limestone formations and soaking in its enchanting beauty. Continuing our adventure, we explore the tranquil beauty of Tamco in Ning Bin, also known as the Harlong Bay on land, where towering limestone rise from the emerald waters. Then we head to Hanoi to take a flight to Hui, the former imperial capital of Vietnam, where we delve into the rich history and cultural heritage of the region. From here, we take the train to Daang, a vibrant city on the central coast of Vietnam. 25 minutes away is Hoyan. We explore the ancient streets where lanterns sway gently in the breeze and history comes to life at every turn. Our adventure reaches its peak in the vibrant metropolis of Ho Chi Min City, also known as Saigon, where we discover the energy and excitement of urban life in Vietnam's largest city. Some information you will need before arriving in Vietnam. Best time to visit Vietnam depends on what you want to explore. Northern Vietnam, April to June and September to December. Early October for the green rice terraces. Central Vietnam, February to May. South Vietnam, November to April for dry season. Mentioning these, April should be your goal to go if you want to see all the country. Lastly, at the end of the video, we will break down how much this trip will cost you and show you an alternative budget friendly route if you have more time to spend in Vietnam. Arriving Hanoi, the heart and soul of Vietnam, where you can lose yourself in the chaotic charm of the old quarter. Here are some places to visit. Stroll around the labyrinthine streets of the old quarter and wander through its narrow streets filled with ancient charm and vibrant shops. Try Hanoi's unique and famous egg coffee at the iconic cafe jam, the birthplace of this amazing tasting coffee. Get a customtailored suit crafted by skilled craftsmen in the heart of Hanoi, all within a swift 24-hour time frame. Experience serenity amidst the bustling city by strolling around the picturesque Hong Kim Lake. Home to the historic Nox Sun Temple nestled on its tranquil waters. A cozy spot where vintage decor and aromatic coffee create the perfect ambiance for a leisurely morning. Check out the spectacle of the famous Train Street, where cafes stand just inches away from passing trains, creating a truly unique and mesmerizing experience. Treat your taste buds to the flavors of Vietnam with a mouthwatering banani sandwich, steaming bowl of faux noodle soup, or dectable king rotty pastry. Each offering a unique culinary experience. From Hanoi, we venture north to the picturesque town of Sappa. Best way to reach Sappa is via night bus from Hanoi. It will take you around 6 hours to arrive. Trek through stunning rice terraces, visit local villages, and immerse yourself in the rich culture of the ethnic minority groups. Embark on a serene boat journey along the river, where towering limestone casts and lush greenery create a breathtaking backdrop for your adventure.
